Belated review of the cardiology consultation service provided by Vet Minerva Torres at the dog shelter. I do not recommend it.
She arrived late, and once in the office, she took a very long time to prepare her equipment for my pet's echocardiogram. She was very repetitive in what she was looking at, and in the end, she kept us there watching her take forever to put away her equipment. All this so that after a total of three hours, she could tell us that she would send the report later, that the treatment would depend on that, and that we had to come back for another consultation.
We went to her appointment expecting professionalism, and there was none. We left without a diagnosis. Later, I found out that she is not a cardiologist; she only does imaging studies. We left paying $2,900 for wasting three hours and getting neither results nor interpretation, nor an effective consultation with a cardiologist.
Terrible.
If you are looking for a cardiology consultation, make sure the doctor is a cardiologist and don't fall for this scam. It's about the health of a living being, and there should be transparency from the clinic. It also shows professionalism on the part of the doctor, who should not give consultations that are not within his area of ​​expertise.
I took my puppy to the dermatologist and I really liked the service, plus the consultation and medications were very affordable.
Very good experience, excellent service, they always take great care of my dogs, especially during shedding season. Highly recommended.

The doctors there are excellent. They were incredibly attentive and kind, and they treated my little girl with such love. They gave her a checkup and a bath. She looks so beautiful! Good prices. Thank you so much.
Amazing service, always.
We love taking our dogs there! They treat them wonderfully.
Excellent service; the staff is always incredibly attentive and careful with my pets. I would never change vets; I always recommend them.

Jorge saw my dog who has been having some stomach problems. He was incredibly thorough and recommended some great substitutions to his diet to help with his GI issues. He wasn’t trying to push a certain type of food and he also wasn’t judgemental at all about what we had been doing so far. We have a great plan now and will check in again in a few weeks. The best vet I’ve seen in Mexico City.
Excellent service!!

A few hours ago, I had a sad experience with the staff at this clinic. A girl and I arrived with a small dog we found on a nearby street; she was injured and looked like she'd been hit by a car. We went there intending to give her medical attention, believing they would see her immediately, since she could barely stand.

We waited for about 30 minutes without receiving any help or guidance. The only thing the staff said to us was, "They found her on the street." They didn't offer any guidance, explain why they couldn't treat her, or tell us what we could do. Finally, the girl who was with me had to take the dog somewhere else to get the care she needed.

I urge the staff to show empathy toward the living beings who arrive needing help. I understand that everything has a cost, but at least providing information or initial care would make a huge difference.

Good luck.
The place and service are very nice, I recommend it.

Excellent doctors, kind and dedicated to their work, they always kept an eye on my puppy Toby, 🐶♥️ sadly he's no longer with us 🕊 but I'm grateful for their attention and follow-up care. Highly recommended. …
For me, this is one of the best services I've found. The doctors are incredibly kind and always attentive to your pet. I'm truly grateful to have found them and that they care for my dog ​​and cat.

The doctor was very unprofessional, almost as if I were telling him everything to do. He couldn't answer our questions and couldn't give us a diagnosis. I told him about a previous diagnosis, and he just said, "Yeah, right, follow that," without even properly examining my cat. I don't recommend him.

I'm sorry, but I don't understand the many good reviews this place has. I took my dog ​​there, and the doctor couldn't explain himself. He didn't give a cause or possible cause for his supposed diagnosis (he said allergies, but he didn't know what they were or why). He gave the same diagnosis to the Chihuahua he saw before us. My husband had to ask him to check her lungs because he had already jumped to his diagnosis without that examination, nor without checking her teeth, which, by the way, he didn't even do... and I only now see that it was important to check for a possible dental infection. The treatment he prescribed for my dog ​​(a visible third eyelid and reverse sneezing) made her worse.
Highly recommended! I bathed my dog ​​with them and he came out looking gorgeous. I would definitely go back!
I received excellent service 🙂 …
Excellent place, they are very kind and caring with the animals, they always take great care of my cat, and my brother takes his dog there to be bathed and they leave him smelling delicious.
Great service, I've found the best place for my babies
The attention is disgusting, the service and the people who answer messages are extremely arrogant and pedantic.
Excellent

Due to the negligence and incompetence of Dr. Jorge and his clinic, I missed my international flight to Europe and had to spend over $30,000 pesos on a new ticket and additional expenses.

I went to this clinic because they advertise that they specialize in health certificates for international travel with pets. I expected accuracy and professionalism. Unfortunately, it was the complete opposite.

I brought all the required documentation (microchip, implantation certificate, vaccinations, rabies vaccination, etc.). Even so, the veterinarian filled out the health certificate incorrectly on THREE separate occasions, forcing me to return several times to correct basic errors.

On the day of my flight, Customs rejected the document because the certificate omitted the microchip implantation date (which I had provided to him with all the documents beforehand), a mandatory and essential requirement for entering the European Union (which, if he is an expert in this, he should have known). This error was completely avoidable and depended solely on the veterinarian.

When I called him that same morning to ask him to correct his own mistake and send me the correction in PDF format, he refused to help and said it “wasn’t his responsibility,” even though he knew I would miss my flight and face significant financial losses.

A travel certificate is a legal document that requires accuracy. If a clinic that advertises itself as a specialist can’t correctly complete something so basic, it doesn’t inspire confidence for more delicate or medical procedures.

I don’t recommend this clinic for travel arrangements or for services where responsibility and care are essential.

Pet owners: look for a more professional and meticulous option.

This is Lunita. She was going to visit this branch for her cardiologist appointment (she had heart failure). She had an appointment in 8 days, but sadly, Luna passed away today, January 26th, from cardiac arrest and didn't make it to her appointment. 💔
I'm taking the time to write because they were so kind to me. I had put down a $500 deposit to reserve her appointment, and when I wrote to them explaining the situation, they refunded it without any problem. I will definitely visit them again with Luna's siblings. 🫂
The staff is very professional and the service is excellent.
Excellent service
Hi, we'd like to know the reason for your review. That helps us continually improve. Best regards 🐶👋. …

It was very difficult for me to contact a veterinary cardiologist because there are very few and they are extremely booked; however, I sent my message and received a very prompt response. The cardiologist examined my 15-year-old dog and was able to accurately diagnose her with the tests he performed. I am very satisfied with the care I received. I wholeheartedly recommend him.
They always treat Goyito very well; they are very kind and have good products.
Very good service, very attentive to the puppies
I called for some information, they were very kind and it was a day they weren't working, thank you very much
It's an acceptable place, but it should be cleaner and have the prices of the main services clearly displayed.
Excellent service and attention both in-store and online :) Highly recommended

I brought my dog who was experiencing swelling of his eye here. My dog could barely open his eye and the veterinarian diagnosed him with dry eye. I asked what the worst possible outcome could be and he said moisturizing eye drops would be solve any issue. In fact, my dog had glaucoma and went blind in his eye because of this misdiagnosis. Perhaps this vet is fine for a routine health certificate but I would not trust him with any actual health issues.
They always treat my dog ​​very well, the location and prices are excellent.

Good service.
Affordable prices.

My puppy was so happy after his bath!
He came home looking so handsome! Everyone was so happy!

And we loved that he got lots of treats!
First time we've been and she left happy, they gave her some clothes and sent me her picture! We're going back!!!

I love taking Vaquero to his baths here!
The service is excellent and they make him look brand new! Hahaha 🤣 Plus, I always look forward to the picture after his baths! …

The grooming service is excellent; they treated my dog ​​incredibly well and returned her to me looking spotless in just under an hour.
My dogs go there for baths, vaccinations, deworming, and general checkups. They have good promotions and excellent customer service.
All the vets at the dog shelter are very knowledgeable and have a great attitude when treating patients 🫶🏼 We've been taking our dog there for 3 years and we have no complaints …

Very convenient in terms of location and prices. They're also veterinarians.
Plus, you can find everything for your furry friends.

My dog ​​Cuba gets her vaccinations and baths here, and she always goes happily because they treat her so well and make her look so beautiful! They also have a good variety of Nupec food, and she loves their natural treats.
The doctor was super attentive, he examined my baby very thoroughly and prescribed treatment; she's improving. I also bought a very cute little sweater.

Kanek's service is always excellent.
Very good service at a good price.
Everything was excellent, they treated my children very well.
